cmqwkgg3k05rqnwqoq8a6u4vk.entry: A thesis-based master's degree is required, or a bachelor's degree of at least ten semesters not counting a preparatory year (for example Medicine, Dentistry, Veterinary Medicine or Pharmacy), which counts as a master's. Applying with any other bachelor's degree requires a bachelor's GPA of at least 3.00/4 and ALES 80 (or a YÖK-recognised equivalent). With a master's degree, the university's graduate regulation asks for ALES, or a YÖK-recognised equivalent, of at least 55 in the programme's score type, and candidates are ranked with ALES weighted at least 50%. The regulation also makes a foreign-language score of at least 55 in YDS/YÖKDİL or an equivalent international exam, in a language other than your native language, mandatory. The admission procedures for international applicants are set separately by the University Senate, so confirm with the Institute whether ALES and the language score apply to you.
cmqwkgg3k05rqnwqoq8a6u4vk.language: International students registering for a Turkish-taught PhD programme must have Turkish at least C1.

cmqwkg8ez01ypnwqojbfsy7ma.language: An English certificate is not required to apply. TOEFL iBT 78, PTE Academic 71, Cambridge CAE or CPE grade C, or YDS/YÖKDİL 80 exempts you from English preparatory school. Without one, you take the university's English proficiency exam; if you fail it you study one year of English prep (one extra year allowed; failing prep two years in a row ends registration). IELTS is not listed in the exemption table.
documents: Notarised copy of the high-school diploma (with translation if not in English or Turkish), or an official school letter confirming graduation before final registration
Official high-school transcript in a sealed envelope (with approved Turkish translation if not in Turkish)

cmqwkgg3n05unnwqozufxylvv.language: A Turkish certificate is not required to apply. cmqwkgg3l05slnwqodwovaaoc.entry: A thesis-based master's degree is required, or a bachelor's degree of at least ten semesters not counting a preparatory year (for example Medicine, Dentistry, Veterinary Medicine or Pharmacy), which counts as a master's. The regulation also makes a foreign-language score of at least 55 in YDS/YÖKDİL or an equivalent international exam, in a language other than your native language, mandatory. The admission procedures for international applicants are set separately by the University Senate, so confirm with the Institute whether ALES and the language score apply to you.
cmqwkgg3l05slnwqodwovaaoc.language: The university's graduate regulation requires a foreign-language score for PhD admission. For English-taught programmes it must be in English: at least 55 in YDS/YÖKDİL, or the equivalent score in an international exam recognised as equivalent by Türkiye's Inter-University Board; the Senate may set a higher minimum. The Senate sets the rules for international applicants separately, so confirm the accepted exams with the Institute.
